spans.s:
अवे अवे (अव-इ), cl. 2. P. अवैति, -तुम्, to
go away, to move away; to go to (with acc.); to
come down upon, rush upon; to look upon, consider;
perceive, conceive, understand, learn, know: Intens.
or Pass. अवेयते, to beg pardon for, conciliate.

अवेत, अस्, आ, अम्, elapsed, past; one who has
gained, obtained, attained; joined with.

अवेक्ष् अवेक्ष् (अव-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. अवेक्-
षते, -षितुम्, to look towards, look at, consider;
to perceive, observe, experience; to have in view,
aim at; to have regard to, respect; to expect, hope
for: Caus. अवेक्षयति, -यितुम्, to cause to look at.

अवेक्षण, अम्, n. looking towards or at; the
act of considering, attention, observation.

अवेक्षणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be looked at, to be
respected.

अवेक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, looking at, inspecting,
examining.

अवेक्षा, f. seeing, looking at; observation, care,
regard, attention to (with loc.); agreement, engage-
ment.

अवेक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, looked at, perceived, re-
garded.
अवेक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, observing, seeing, looking at.

1. अवेक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be regarded, to be re-
spected.
2. अवेक्ष्य, ind. having beheld, having regarded.

अवेणि अ-वेणि, इस्, इस्, इ, not braided, having
no braid of hair; not commingled (as the waters of
rivers).

अवेदयान अ-वेदयान, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. 1. विद्),
not knowing, not ascertaining.

अ-वेद-विद्, त्, m. a Brāhman who has not studied
the Vedas.

अ-वेद-विहित, अस्, आ, अम्, not enjoined in the
Vedas, unscriptural.

1. अ-वेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be known; un-
ascertainable, secret.

अवेद्य 2. अ-वेद्य, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. 2. विद्),
not to be married; (अस्), m. a calf.
1. आ-वेद्य, ind. having made known.

2. आ-वेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be represented or made
known.

अवेनत् अ-वेनत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. un-
conscious, not perceiving.

अवेन्व् अवेन्व् (अव-इन्व्), cl. 1. P., Ved. अवेन्-
वति, -वितुम्, to send away.

अवेल अवेल (अव-इला?), अस्, m. denial or
concealment of knowledge; (आ), f. chewed betel.

अवेष्टि अवेष्टि, इस्, f. (fr. rt. यज् with अव),
Ved. appeasing or expiation by sacrifices.

आ-वेदक, अस्, आ, अम्, making known, reporting,
announcing; (अस्), m. an appellant, a suitor; one who
makes known, an informer.
आवेदक, आवेदन, &c. See under 1. आ-विद्.

आ-वेदन, अम्, n. representation, stating a com-
plaint, addressing or apprising respectfully.

आ-वेदनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be declared or reported
or announced.

आ-वेदित, अस्, आ, अम्, made known, communicated,
represented.
आ-वेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, announcing, declaring.

आ-वेद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being made known,
stated or represented.
आवेश आ-वेश, &c. See under आ-विश्.

आ-वेशन, अम्, n. entering, entrance; possession by
devils, &c.; passion, anger, fury; a house in which
work is carried on, a workshop, a manufactory, &c.;
the disk of the sun or moon.

आवेशिक, अस्, ई, अम्, own, peculiar; inherent; (अस्,
ई, अम्), m. f. n. a guest, a visitor; (अम्), n. entering
into; hospitable reception, hospitality.

आवेग आ-वेग, अस्, m. (rt. विज्), hurry, haste
produced by excitement; flurry, agitation; (ई), f. the
plant Convolvolus Argenteus.

आवेणिक आवेणिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अ-वेणि), not
connected with anything else; independant.

आवेष्ट आ-वेष्ट, अस्, m. (rt. वेष्ट्), sur-
rounding, covering with.
आ-वेष्टक, अस्, m. a wall, a fence, an enclosure.

आ-वेष्टन, अम्, n. wrapping round, binding, ty-
ing; a wrapper, an envelope, a bandage; an en-
closure.

आ-वेष्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, enveloped, in-
closed, bound or tied.

आ-वेध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be pierced, pinned on,
put on.
आ-वेध, अस्, m. (fr. आ-व्यध्), shaking about.
